pdf.subtitle: A sidereal birth-chart reading, computed on your device.
pdf.birth_details_intro: The exact moment and place of birth from which every placement in this report is derived.
pdf.technical_note: Computed with the Lahiri ayanamsa and the whole-sign house system. All values are emitted by the AlmaMesh engine on your device.
pdf.planets_intro: The sidereal longitude of each graha at the moment of birth — its sign, exact degree, nakshatra, house, and dignity. The State column names each graha's special conditions in words: "Combust" with the measured separation from the Sun, and "Retro (R)" for retrograde motion. Every combustion is then spelled out in full beneath the table, orb included.
pdf.houses_intro: The twelve whole-sign houses counted from the Ascendant — each house's sign, its ruling planet, and the grahas placed within it.
pdf.charts_intro: The birth chart (D1 Rāśi) and the navāṁśa (D9), the divisional chart of marriage, dharma, and inner strength — both in the classical North-Indian diamond, houses fixed, signs rotating.
pdf.dasha_intro: The 120-year planetary period system keyed to the Moon’s nakshatra at birth. Each mahā-daśā colours a long chapter of life; the period running today is labelled “Current” on its own row (and tinted brass).
pdf.yogas_intro: The named planetary combinations the engine identifies in this chart, with their classical grade. A yoga is a tendency, never a verdict.
pdf.narrative_intro: A reading woven from the placements above — strengths, challenges, life themes, and guidance across the major life domains.
pdf.narrative_absent_note: No AI reading has been generated for this chart yet, so the written interpretation is not printed here. Generating one is optional and uses your own API key — everything else in this report is complete and unaffected.
pdf.evidence_intro: The audit of everything above: each computed observation, the values it rests on, the confidence those values support, and the reading that would apply if the birth time were a little different. Work through the method once and you can re-derive every level yourself.
pdf.transits_intro: Where the grahas stand in today's sidereal sky against the natal chart — Sade Sati, slow-graha hits, the daśā × transit fusion, and the twelve-month timeline.
pdf.vargas_intro: The Shodaśavarga: sixteen harmonic divisions of the birth chart, each refining one arena of life — marriage (D9), career (D10), parents (D12), and beyond — closed by the Vargottama flags and the Viṁśopaka Bala tally.
pdf.strength_intro: Ashtakavarga bindus and the six-fold Ṣaḍbala — the classical strength arithmetic behind every judgement in this report.
pdf.domains_intro: Seven life domains read deterministically from houses, karakas, vargas, and current timing — the engine's synthesis, not AI narration.
pdf.rectification_intro: How the working birth time of this chart was established, and the dated life events that support it.

rectification.heading: Birth Time Authority

mode.cusp: Cusp resolution — two adjacent rising signs compared
mode.window: Time-window scan — candidate birth times across the stated window compared against dated life events

rectification.confidence_inconclusive: Inconclusive — not enough dated events to tell your candidate times apart
rectification.confidence_meaning: This confidence is how much better your best-fit time explains your events than the runner-up — not the odds the time itself is correct.
rectification.events_empty: No dated life events are attached to this rectification.
rectification.prior_note: The confirmed time sits closest to the recorded time — a gentle nudge in the fit; the dated events always carried more weight.
rectification.caveat: Event-based rectification resolves the rising sign, not the exact minute. Both times are kept on record; the working time above is the authority for every house placement in this report.

assumptions.intro: Every verdict in this report rests on these four choices. They are stated plainly here so nothing is hidden.
assumptions.house_system_value: Whole-sign houses (each house is one whole sign from the ascendant)

evidence.heading: Evidence & Confidence
evidence.method_heading: How every confidence level below was worked out
evidence.ceiling_heading: Step 1 — the ceiling, set by how the cited values were computed
evidence.ceiling_arithmetic_reason: The number is the computation. A daśā period is the Moon's nakshatra fraction scaled by a declared year length; a second implementation gets the same answer.
evidence.ceiling_rule_reason: Exact arithmetic, but which rule is a classical choice: which sign exalts a graha, what orb makes it combust, which house system counts. Schools differ.
evidence.ceiling_model_reason: A calibrated structural estimate over the plus/minus one mark lattice — a quantity this engine defined, not one the tradition hands down. The report already labels these a structural estimate.
evidence.ceiling_min_note: A claim's ceiling is the lowest of everything it cites: a conclusion is only as good as its weakest support.
evidence.deduction_heading: Step 2 — deductions, one for each fragility measured in this chart
evidence.deduction_lagna_fork: Lagna fork — the ascendant is within {{cusp}} of a sign boundary and this claim cites something house-dependent. Under whole-sign houses the flip is total: every house moves at once.
evidence.deduction_sign_boundary: Sign boundary — a cited dignity or position sits within {{margin}} of a sign edge, where dignity and sign lord both change.
evidence.deduction_combustion_boundary: Combustion boundary — a cited combustion verdict sits within {{margin}} of its own orb, so the verdict is one convention away from flipping.
evidence.deduction_net_zero_marks: Net-zero marks — a cited structural strength nets to zero, which the lattice produces both when factors genuinely cancel and when nothing fired at all. The number cannot tell those apart.
evidence.formula: level = ceiling - (number of deductions), floored at Low.
evidence.alternate_heading: The second chart this birth time could have
evidence.alternate_lead: Under a {{sign}} ascendant ({{degrees}} away), every house moves at once:
evidence.alternate_lead_unavailable: A {{sign}} ascendant is {{degrees}} away, so every house-dependent finding must be recomputed.
evidence.alternate_minutes_note: How many minutes of birth time that is, this report does not compute: it depends on the latitude, the date, and how fast the rising sign ascends. The distance in degrees is stated instead, because that is the quantity that was actually measured.
evidence.alternate_projection_unavailable: Exact house shifts are withheld because the stored house placements did not pass the report's whole-sign consistency check. That does not make the ascendant secure.
evidence.no_interpretation: No written interpretation — generate a reading to add one.

evidence.observation_rulership_yogakaraka_other: {{planet}} rules houses {{houses}} and is yogakāraka for this ascendant.

evidence.alternative_lagna_fork_all: Under a {{sign}} ascendant ({{degrees}} away) the whole house frame moves.
evidence.alternative_lagna_fork_unavailable: Under a {{sign}} ascendant ({{degrees}} away), this house-dependent claim must be recomputed. Exact shifts are withheld because the stored house frame failed the whole-sign consistency check.
evidence.alternative_orb_robustness: The combustion verdict holds until the separation crosses the {{orb}} orb; it measures {{separation}}, which is {{margin}} away from flipping.
evidence.alternative_dasha_convention: Under the other year lengths this engine knows, the period boundaries move: {{shifts}}
evidence.alternative_sign_edge: {{planet}} sits {{margin}} from a sign edge; a birth time a few minutes out could place it in the next sign, changing both its dignity and its sign lord.
evidence.alternative_lattice_ambiguity: {{name}} nets {{net}} marks against +{{favorable}} favourable / -{{unfavorable}} unfavourable. Zero here means either genuine cancellation or nothing firing at all, and the lattice cannot distinguish them.
evidence.reason_apparent_motion: retrogradation is apparent motion, read straight off the speed the ephemeris already prints — no school disputes the direction.
evidence.reason_ascendant_secure: the ascendant sits well inside its sign, so there is no second house frame to compare against.
evidence.reason_dignity_by_sign: this rests on sign placement alone, which reads identically if the rising sign flips.
evidence.reason_structural_declared: the figure is already declared a structural estimate, and the report labels it as one wherever it appears.
